newsitem.title: USA: Compaq offers Presario 2000 PC for $999.
newsitem.headline: Compaq offers Presario 2000 PC for $999.

text.p: Compaq Computer Corp said Thursday it was offering a full-featured multimedia personal computer at a price of $999.
The new Presario 2000 series is available immediately.
The line features fast processors, large amounts of memory, spacious hard-drives, super-fast Internet access and a PremierSound audio system, Compaq said.

The first computer in the series is the Presario 2100. It features a 133 MHz processor with MediaGX technology of Cyrix Corp. The PC lets consumers speed through Windows-based applications, Compaq said.
The computer has 24 MB of memory for fast data retrieval, a 33.6 K modem for "super-fast" Internet access, a 2.0 GB hard drive for large storage capacity, and an 8X CD ROM drive.
Compaq said the PC comes with a one-year U.S. limited warranty and 24-hour, seven-days-a-week technical support.
The Presario 2100 can be paired with the new Presario V400 color monitor, which is also available immediately, Compaq said.
The "sealed box" design of the Presario 2000 series represents a move toward a new category of PCs endorsed by many industry leaders, it said.
The Presario 2100 is available immediately at retail locations throughout the U.S., including Comp USA, Best Buy, Circuit City, Computer City, Office Depot, Office Max, Staples, and others, it said.
The new PC series is initially being introduced in North and Latin America and is expected to be launched later this year in Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia, it said.
Compaq is the fifth largest computer company in the world and the largest global supplier of personal computers.
